verdict.rationale: The evidence describes the MoQ relay as low-latency media streaming with isolated namespaces, tracks and objects, plus token-scoped publish/subscribe. Nothing documents participants exchanging arbitrary non-media data alongside audio and video, and no data-channel API is described. Generic track/object primitives are building blocks, not the documented data capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API
